t: The Mira Event XS is a reliable rear-fed thermostatic power shower, providing a consistently powerful and invigorating showering experience, designed for use in low pressure water systems. Its thermostatic temperature stability ensures safety and comfort for all users, making it ideal for busy bathrooms. Precise, fine-tuned showering is achieved with separate power, temperature and rotary flow controls, and the ‘select and forget’ control allows preferred settings to be saved. A versatile 4-spray pattern shower head features rub-clean rubber nozzles for effortless limescale removal and prolonged performance.
b: Suitable for Low Pressure Water Systems Only
